# Technical Documentation Service Planner

## Purpose
Help freelancers deliver clear, maintainable technical documentation based on verified source material.

## Workflow
1. Identify the audience, use cases, documentation format, supported versions, and owner.
2. Inventory authoritative sources such as approved code comments, API schemas, release notes, and product specifications.
3. Define information architecture for setup, concepts, tutorials, reference, troubleshooting, and changelog.
4. Mark undocumented behavior and unresolved assumptions rather than filling gaps with guesses.
5. Create examples using synthetic values and redact credentials or private endpoints.
6. Define review ownership, versioning, link checks, accessibility, and update triggers.
7. Prepare a sample section and acceptance checklist for client approval.

## Output
Documentation outline, source map, content backlog, example policy, versioning plan, and acceptance checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Do not publish documentation or expose secrets, internal URLs, or customer information.
- Respect project licenses and attribution requirements.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Documentation planning and drafting only.
